frostedfoliage.screen.title: Frosted Foliage Settings
frostedfoliage.command.preview: Showing plants frosted to %s%% (until you run /frostedfoliage preview off)
frostedfoliage.command.preview_off: Frost now follows the real weather again
frostedfoliage.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, plants look the same in snow as in any other weather.
frostedfoliage.option.whiten_seconds.too: How many seconds of snowfall it takes for plants to turn completely white. They whiten a little at a time while it snows.
frostedfoliage.option.melt_seconds.toolt: How many seconds after the snow stops until the white is gone again. Never keeps plants white until you leave the world.
frostedfoliage.option.variation.tooltip: How unevenly plants whiten. At 0 every plant changes at the same moment; higher values let some turn white sooner than others.
frostedfoliage.option.whiten_sides.toolt:
On: anything with open sky beside it turns white, so the whole outside of a tree is white, not just its top.
Off: only what is open to the sky from above turns white.
Leaves buried inside a tree, and plants under a roof or a tree, stay as they are either way.
frostedfoliage.option.cover_layers.toolt:
How many blocks of cover can sit above a plant before snow no longer reaches it.
0: nothing may be above it.
Higher: leaves further inside a tree, and plants under a thin roof of leaves, turn white too.
frostedfoliage.option.steps.tooltip: How many stages the whitening is split into. More stages look smoother, but chunks are rebuilt more often while the snow builds up.
